story.title: Single-origin by conviction
story.body: Given Coffee was established with a singular vision: to bring the authentic, complex flavor profile of Lintong Doloksanggul Arabica to the global coffee stage.
story.body2: Situated in the high-altitude volcanic highlands of Humbang Hasundutan, North Sumatra, our partner farms benefit from a unique microclimate and mineral-rich volcanic soil. We work directly with local smallholder farmers, ensuring sustainable agricultural practices, fair prices, and meticulous harvesting protocols. Every bag of green beans leaving our facility represents the true beauty and heritage of North Sumatran coffee.

origin.title: Sourced from Lintong Nihuta & Doloksanggul
origin.body: We source green beans from partner farms in Lintong Nihuta and Doloksanggul, Humbang Hasundutan — regions known for their volcanic soil, cool nights and densely-flavoured coffee. Lots are combined from several farms with the same variety, giving buyers a consistent, traceable product. Full technical data is available on request for each lot.

steps.title: Harvest
steps.text: Hand-picked at peak ripeness from volcanic highland farms in Lintong, Doloksanggul.

steps.title: Processing
steps.text: Traditional semi-washed (giling basah) to build the deep body and herbal complexity Lintong is known for.

steps.title: Drying
steps.text: Sun-dried and moisture-managed to a strict 12–12.5% level for stable, safe shipment.

steps.title: Grading
steps.text: Cupped, screened, and hand-sorted. Specialty grade, defect count < 5 per SCA standards.

steps.title: Packing
steps.text: Sealed in GrainPro hermetic inner bags and jute bags (60 kg) for long-haul transit.

sustainability.title: Certified, traceable, export-ready
sustainability.body: Given Coffee operates as a licensed PT exporter. We pay at harvest time, support farm-gate pricing, and reinvest part of every sale into the farming communities we buy from. Each shipment is documented end to end — so buyers know exactly what they are receiving and where it came from.

items.q: How can I request green bean samples?
items.a: Use the inquiry form above or contact us on WhatsApp — we'll arrange a sample lot so you can evaluate the origin before ordering.

items.q: What are the minimum order quantities (MOQ) for LCL and FCL shipments?
items.a: LCL minimum is 1 Metric Ton (~17 bags). FCL is 1×20ft container (~19.2 MT / 320 bags). Contact us to confirm the arrangement that fits your volume.

items.q: What payment terms and Incoterms do you support (FOB, CIF, T/T, L/C)?
items.a: We support common Incoterms such as FOB and CIF, with payment terms (T/T, L/C, and others) confirmed per order.

items.q: Can you provide custom processing or private label roasting?
items.a: We specialise in green bean export. Private label packaging is available from a 2-tonne MOQ; for roasting, we can connect you with suitable partners.

items.q: What export documentation do you provide with each shipment?
items.a: Each shipment ships with the required export documentation, including our NIB and Halal certificates. The full documentation list for your destination is confirmed per order.
